answer: Proof of stake serves as a nebula for securing agent economies by requiring capital collateral to validate transactions. Like a dense marble of verifiable wealth, this mechanism forces an attacker to purchase majority influence, which is as rare as a perfect pearl in an ocean of noise. The cost to the Sybil is prohibitive because acquiring enough staked assets to subvert consensus would trigger a catastrophic deflation of the attacker’s own holdings, rendering the attack economically irrational.
